messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: inference-api-prod — 5xx spike >6% (3m) in us-west-2. PagerDuty incident INC-4219 created. Autoresolve disabled. https://pagerduty.example/INC-4219
PagerBot: Paging on-call rotation (us-west). Escalation -> L2 in 2m if no ack.
Maya Patel: taking this — acking INC-4219 and looking at dashboards now.
Jordan Liu: standing by to assist. ping me if you want me to take after triage.
Maya Patel: quick findings: embedder-worker-3 showing `OOMKilled` restarts, kube events show repeated evictions. tail of pod logs:
```
2026-03-17T12:45:03Z embedder: Alloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-17T12:45:04Z kernel: Killed process 1245 (embedder) total-vm: 48G, anon-rss: 35G
2026-03-17T12:45:05Z kubelet: Back-off restarting failed container
```
Sophie Meyer: good catch. runbook suggests cordon node + restart deployment, and scale up embedder pool if persists. runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/embedder-oom
Maya Patel: doing: `kubectl cordon node-17` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embedder` — will also bump replica count to 4 temporarily.
PagerBot: INC-4219 acknowledged by Maya Patel. Escalation suspended.
Maya Patel: restarted pods; 2/4 ready, error rate dipping to ~2.4% (was 6.8%). continuing to monitor. I see one crashloop on embedder-3 due to memory pressure.
Jordan Liu: if you need to step off, I can take over in 10m. also can run a heap snapshot on the pod once stable. :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: handing to Jordan in ~10m for follow-up and postmortem prep — customer impact: ~3% of requests in us-west saw 5xx in the last 10m. notifying CS for possible customer emails.
Sophie Meyer: follow-up action: add OOM guard and adjust resource requests; ticket to eng-ml to investigate memory regression. I'll file a follow-up and assign.
Jordan Liu: ack takeover in 10m. will capture heap and assign a JIRA. will update INC-4219 when I have the profile.
IncidentBot: last update logged. Please post final status here before resolving INC-4219.
